a: Third normal form reduces redundancy by removing transitive dependencies.
Fact tables + dimension tables for analytics warehouses.
Normalized dimensions in a star-like warehouse model.
Surrogate keys are system-generated ids independent of business meaning.
Natural keys come from the domain (email, ISBN) but can change.
deleted_at flags hide rows without physical delete; index carefully.
Type+id references are flexible but weaken FK integrity.
JSON columns fit evolving attributes; query heavily? consider tables.
Model 1:1, 1:N, M:N explicitly with join tables when needed.
